description: Cross-FEAT integration verification: run full build, test all country pages end-to-end, verify design consistency across all 6 countries
steps: Run npm run build to verify production build succeeds without errors
Start npm run dev and systematically test all 6 country main pages: /study-in-canada, /study-in-ireland, /study-in-uae, /study-in-russia, /study-in-australia, /study-in-germany

For each country, verify all 10 components render in correct order: Hero, OnlineDegreeSection, WhatItGetsYou, CoursesSlider, HowUniversityYatraHelps, UniversityCarousel, CostOfStudying, Testimonials, GlobalEducationCTA
Test all 5 guide pages for each country (30 total guide pages): study-in-{country}, cost-of-studying, living-and-culture, scholarships, post-study-work-visa
Verify design consistency: compare all 6 country pages side-by-side to ensure Canada design system applied uniformly (colors, spacing, typography, animations)
Test responsive behavior on mobile (375px), tablet (768px), and desktop (1440px) for at least 2 countries
Check browser console for any errors, warnings, or React hydration mismatches across all pages
Verify navigation: test Navbar destination links between countries, footer links, breadcrumb navigation in guides
Verify metadata: check page titles and descriptions are country-specific
Create a findings summary documenting any visual inconsistencies, missing images, or areas needing refinement
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes successfully with no errors
All 6 country main pages render without errors or console warnings
All 30 guide pages (6 countries × 5 guides) render correctly
Visual design is consistent across all 6 countries following Canada pattern
All WhatsApp links, guide navigation, and internal links work correctly
Responsive behavior works on mobile, tablet, desktop
No React errors, hydration mismatches, or import failures
verification: Run npm run build and confirm exit code 0
Run npm run dev and manually test each of 6 country pages
Test guide navigation from OnlineDegreeSection for all countries
Compare screenshots of all 6 countries' Hero sections to verify design consistency
Check Network tab for 404 errors on images or assets
Document findings in FEAT-007 findings field for any issues requiring follow-up
